text: Drag-along rights raise the price the majority can obtain because a buyer facing the prospect of continuing with remaining minority shareholders would otherwise discount its offer for the majority stake.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612

isBasedOn.name: Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America

abstract: Drag-along rights allow majority shareholders to maximize the chance of receiving full value for their shares because the prospect of having to work with the remaining minority shareholders may lead an interested party to offer a discounted price for the majority stake.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: sale of a majority stake in a closely held corporation
